record.question: The Scheme shall also not apply to persons recruited under the State Government after attaining the age of _____ years
record.explanation: The MSGEGIS 2014 scheme applies only to regular Mizoram Government employees recruited before attaining the age of 50 years, as confirmed by question 44 in the UDC LDE Paper-III (August 2025) which states eligibility is for those 'recruited under the State Government before attaining the age of 50 years'. Therefore, the scheme does not apply to persons recruited after attaining the age of 50 years.
